dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Distinct pale horizontal bands are visible across the median and greater coverts with moderate grayscale contrast and medium thickness.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent and sharp pale edges are visible along the boundaries of the folded secondary and tertiary feathers against darker feather centers.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced repetitive scalloping pattern formed by high-contrast pale feather margins across the entire dorsal surface.
